metadata.ratingExplanation: Head-coach honors receive full competition-specific value. Assistant, consultant and youth honors receive reduced value. Player achievements remain in the database but receive zero coaching points. Experience is added and raw scores are percentile-ranked across the scraped European pool. The 99th percentile and above is capped at 90.

coaches.name: Don Casey
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Italy by team

biography.introduction: Lawrence Donald Casey (born June 17, 1937) is an American former professional and collegiate basketball coach. He has coached two National Basketball Association (NBA) teams, the Los Angeles Clippers and the New Jersey Nets—each for a season and a half. He had previously coached the Temple Owls from 1973 to 1982. He also worked as an assistant coach with the Chicago Bulls (1982–83) and Boston Celtics (1990–1996).
